from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import hashlib, json

class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.urls = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            href = dict(attrs).get('href') or ''
            url = urlparse(href)
            if url.scheme == 'https' and url.hostname == 'www.find-tender.service.gov.uk' and '105246-2026' in url.path:
                self.urls.append(href)

source = Path('products/distribution/expiry-verification/open-software-tenders-2026-11-18.html')
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '88912c1277b5f420586cc02e4a53039704d5bc36c8dd4a6c3178fbd5647aaec1', 'Snapshot differs from TASK-179499456101'
parser = Links()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
print(json.dumps({'snapshot': str(source), 'sha256': digest, 'official_links': sorted(set(parser.urls))}, indent=2))
